name: @squarehole/indexer
description: Live curve indexer and SSE gateway (proof of concept, branch sh-realtime-poc; F38 (2)). Optional accelerator (C19, UI-12): the service is read-only, with no keys, no transactions and no swap code. Test tooling only (scripts/fork-e2e.ts) sends router buys and PoolSwapTest swaps, to a LOCAL anvil fork with impersonated accounts; it is never part of the service or of any bundle. Follows one v4 pool over a websocket head feed with a polling fallback, derives the curve state with exact v4 math, keeps hot state in Redis (or an in-memory store behind the same interface) and serves a snapshot endpoint and an SSE stream.

scripts.test:history: SH_HISTORY_PG=1 vitest run --maxWorkers 4 test/history test/links test/pictures test/core/set-v2
